# uPlot 1.6.32

These unmodified browser assets and MIT license come from the published
`uplot@1.6.32` npm package.

- Upstream: https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/uplot/-/uplot-1.6.32.tgz
- Package integrity: `sha512-KIMVnG68zvu5XXUbC4LQEPnhwOxBuLyW1AHtpm6IKTXImkbLgkMy+jabjLgSLMasNuGGzQm/ep3tOkyTxpiQIw==`

Serve these assets locally. The dashboard does not use a CDN or load third-party
scripts at runtime. When updating, verify the npm package integrity, copy these
same three files, and check cursor alignment, missing samples, resizing, and live
updates in the browser.
